comment: mtg.* vocabularies for the observation transform (observation-schema-v1). Grown data-driven; unknown entries are loud errors at transform time, never silent zeros.
format_features_comment: Build 4 (ADR-0111) format-as-features (design §2): explicit scalars per format id, in FORMAT_SCALARS order — start_life, deck_size, singleton (0/1), command_zone (0/1), mulligan variant (0 = vancouver, 1 = london). A new format adds its row here (a dataset-boundary event, ADR-0018).
